items.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
items.summary: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10.

items.title: Binance Wallet Outflows Widen to Three Accounts in Suspected Hack
items.summary: Records show 823 million USDC left Hot Wallet 34, while Binance 14 was swept again 40 minutes after its initial outflow.

items.title: Binance investigating hack as suspicious outflows reach up to $5.8 billion
items.summary: Tether and Circle froze $1.79 billion in USDT and USDC after billions moved out of Binance hot wallets.

items.title: Binance Drained of $5.5 Billion in Suspected Hack, Tether and Circle Freeze $1.8 Billion
items.summary: An on-chain tally puts the suspected Binance drain at $5.57 billion across three blockchains, as Tether and Circle froze $1.8 billion.
